title: a channel handoff and a returned permit make the other task ready without running it inside the call
purpose: Run the program and observe the order of its output.

stdout.text:
main: sent
main: permit returned
receiver: hello
borrower: got a permit

provenance.origin: authored for #340; Sparrow (Tomato) is the reference behaviour
provenance.expected_basis: #340: send to a waiting receiver and Permit.close() wake the other task; it runs after main suspends, in wake order.
